name: High Pull
instructions: Stand with a barbell at mid-thigh in a hang position, hips back and chest up.
Extend your hips, knees and ankles explosively.
Shrug your shoulders and pull the bar up with your elbows leading, high and outside.
Bring the bar to about chest height.
Lower the bar under control back to the hang position.
longevityNotes: Hip-hinge strength protects the lower back in every lift, from groceries to grandchildren. Strong glutes and hamstrings are the engine of walking, climbing, and standing up.
overview: A power movement where you pull a barbell explosively to chest height with the elbows high.
